# Parser fixtures

Trimmed public New Orleans source responses captured September 30, 2026. These retain the HTML/XML structures needed for parser regression tests. They contain no credentials or user monitoring state.

Sources: Council meeting RSS and September 23 climate committee page; Granicus event 25006; City Planning meetings page; Council and Mayor news listings; Legistar event 1016 item 21203. Full URLs and source context are in `research/README.md`.
